---
title: "Stock Metadata Example"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyquant)
library(quantmod)
library(dplyr)
library(TTR)  # Needed for RSI and MACD

# Get stock data
# stock <- tq_get("AAPL", from = "2000-01-01", to = "2023-12-31")
stock <- tq_get("KUKE", from = "2000-01-01", to = "2023-12-31")


# Calculate 5-day close-to-close percentage performance
stock <- stock %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(`5D Actual Perf` = (close / lag(close, 5) - 1) * 100)

# Calculate RSI and MACD separately
macd_vals <- MACD(stock$close, nFast = 12, nSlow = 26, nSig = 9)

stock <- stock %>%
  mutate(
    RSI_14 = RSI(close, n = 14),
    MACD = macd_vals[, "macd"],
    MACD_signal = macd_vals[, "signal"]
  )

stock <- stock %>%
  select(-adjusted)
head(stock, 20)
```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(stock, aes(x = RSI_14, y = `5D Actual Perf`)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess") +
  labs(title = "RSI vs 5-Day Forward Performance",
       x = "RSI (14)",
       y = "5-Day Actual Performance (%)")

```
